name: kiro-ph-data-dashboard
description: Philippine data dashboard with DuckDB-powered ingestion pipeline and Chart.js visualizations

scripts.db:reset: node -e "import('./src/db.js').then(async({openDatabase,exec,closeDatabase})=>{const{db,con}=openDatabase();await exec(con,'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS population;');await exec(con,'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS gdp;');await closeDatabase(db);console.info('Tables dropped.')})"
